description: A clinic is conducting a throat or nasal swabs on each patient. A throat swab takes 5 minutes while a nasal swab takes 3 minutes. The clinic must administer at least 30 nasal swabs. Since the nasal swab is more uncomfortable, at least 4 times as many throat swabs must be done as nasal swabs. If the clinic is only operational for 20000 minutes, how many of each swab should be done to maximize the number of patients seen?

TimeThroatSwab.definition: Time required to perform one throat swab in minutes

TimeNasalSwab.definition: Time required to perform one nasal swab in minutes

MinimumNasalSwabs.definition: Minimum number of nasal swabs to be performed

ThroatToNasalRatio.definition: Minimum ratio of throat swabs to nasal swabs

TotalOperationalTime.definition: Total operational time available in minutes

objective.description: "Maximize the total number of patients seen (i.e., the total number of throat and nasal swabs performed)"

constraints.description: 5 * (number of throat swabs) + 3 * (number of nasal swabs) ≤ 20000
The number of nasal swabs performed should be at least 30
The number of throat swabs performed should be at least 4 times the number of nasal swabs performed
